after.condition: Native gpt-6-luna Decisions supports Zero Data Retention and HIPAA use for eligible customers, subject to the required agreements and data-control limitations. Data residency is available in all supported API regions; regional processing is supported in the United States and Europe (EEA + Switzerland). This does not establish Copilot data controls, credential eligibility, deployment mappings or AWF networking behavior.

For native gpt-6-luna requests to /v1/decisions only, uncached input costs USD 0.10 per 1M tokens and output tokens are not charged. Cache reads and writes follow the standard gpt-6-luna prompt-caching rates; regional processing premiums and long-context input pricing multipliers apply. Other gpt-6-luna requests use their applicable model and processing-tier pricing. This protocol-scoped observation does not establish numeric cache rates, thresholds, Copilot tariffs or a general model-level zero-output tariff, and does not activate runtime accounting.

Record eligible-customer ZDR/HIPAA and documented residency/processing regions with required-agreement limitations. evidence.quote: Send requests to POST /v1/decisions using gpt-6-luna , the only currently supported model.

With gpt-6-luna , uncached input costs $0.10 per 1M tokens . Prompt cache hits receive discounted input pricing; cache writes are charged. Cache-read and cache-write rates match the standard gpt-6-luna prompt caching rates . Output tokens are not charged. Regional processing premiums and long-context input pricing multipliers apply.
These rates apply to /v1/decisions ; other requests using gpt-6-luna follow the applicable model and processing-tier pricing .

The Decisions API supports Zero Data Retention (ZDR) and HIPAA use for eligible customers. Data residency is available in all supported API regions. Regional processing is supported in the United States and Europe (EEA + Switzerland). See data controls for eligibility requirements, required agreements, and limitations.
